description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to generative AI’s use in journalism. The chart contains two slices, representing “Article generation” and “Headline generation”. “Article generation” is represented by a dark red slice and occupies approximately 83.2% of the chart, while “Headline generation” is represented by a light yellow slice and occupies approximately 16.8% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The chart includes a legend identifying the task types. The slices are arranged clockwise, with the largest slice, “Article generation”, appearing first.
